RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning the panel's gender composition did not disadvantage you on the basis of sex. Raising gender bias would undermine your credibility, as sex was not a deciding factor between two male finalists.

While an all-male selection panel may reflect poorly on the broadcaster's internal diversity practices, it does not demonstrate discrimination against you. The hiring decision appears to have been driven by specific qualifications, notably digital media expertise.

Rather than challenging the panel's composition, follow up politely on your outstanding request for written feedback. Frame your inquiry constructively around learning how to complement your extensive editorial experience with the digital competencies the organization prioritized.
